title: Iran says Trump’s threats a sign of ‘strategic desperation,’ floats conditions for Hormuz reopening
summary_full: Tehran's proposal could pave the way for restoring traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, reviving fragile hopes for a diplomatic off-ramp.
